data.name: The Absolute Basics of Building in Decentraland
data.description:
This session is for those of us who want to build, but don't know where to start! I mean...the absolute beginners! Do we use Blender? Creator Hub? How do I publish to my land? Where is my land? Help!

There are a lot of great learning resources out there... As a Special Education teacher for a decade, I understand the importance of breaking down large tasks into smaller digestible chunks. We all have diverse learning styles (I personally am 110% a visual learner!). Sometimes we need a slow, in-depth environment where we can ask questions even if they've already been asked :) 

I first started building in Decentraland in April of 2019 for the Land Creator Contest. After that, I tried learning the SDK and Blender to advance my builds. I struggled to learn them, and didn't have anyone to ask for help. My hope with "Build it Forward" is to prevent anyone else from feeling discouraged with building in Decentraland! 

This class is intended for users with little to no 3D building experience. So come...bring your basic questions, ask them 10 times if you need to, and we'll build Decentraland together, one brick at a time! 

Sessions will be streamed on the Community Building Decentraland Discord, found here: https://discord.gg/cbdcl

We will also meet in world at La Cantina, coords: -150, 95

Get a FREE OP badge each week for attending!

data.name: Enjoy movies with friends at Watch Party Wednesdays
data.description:
Every Wednesday, you’re invited to gather in Decentraland Theatre for a watch party with some of the world's best documentaries. Each film screens twice, at 2pm UTC and again at 8pm UTC, so you can join from wherever you are.

This season's theme is Being Human: stories about who we are and who we're becoming.

August 26: iHuman
Norway, Denmark | 2019 | 99 min
Language: English

🎬 Documentary by Tonje Hessen Schei, about AI, power, social control, and the impact of artificial intelligence on society.

data.name: THANKS GOD IS FRIDAY!
data.description:
The celebration of the end of the real life job week and the start of DCL weekend
ARE YOU READY?                                                                                   
🫣
If you're not, too bad for you!                                                                                      
Khamusique will lead the way:
Transporting you into a mystical experience whether you're there or not.                                 
_________________________________________________________________________
💫                                                                                                                 
TGIF IS: A MOMENT                                                                                         
It's the moment you leave work on Friday and take that deep breath through your nose, as if you wanted to smell, to perceive that exact moment with as many senses as possible.                                                              
Your bones are vibrating, you're excited because you're shaking off the labels modern society imposes on you, and you're ready to live your EXISTENCE over the weekend.                                                                 
_________________________________________________________________________
♾️
TGIF IS: A LIMBO                                                                                        
It's a brief period of time that should be enjoyed, not let evaporate while waiting for the weekend to begin.                                                                                      
It's the limbo between that initial sniff just outside work and the start of Saturday's day.                                                                                              
_________________________________________________________________________
💃
TGIF IS: TIME TO SIMPLY EXIST
Yes, that's what it's all about: being able to EXIST!                                                                                               
It's not just about surviving by performing the actions that real life forces you to do to fulfill the tasks imposed by modern society.                        
_________________________________________________________________________
🧬
TGIF IS: SELF-EXPRESSION
Those are two hours where you express the most truthful part of yourself!                                                                                                          
Through your wearables, through the emotes you use, through your comments in chat...                                                                                            
Your avatar speaks for you, reflecting how you perceive yourself, regardless of how others may perceive you.

Hosted by the 🧉 Chiri Storytelling Community 🍕

Together we open a new portal to the Impossible Fest, a celebration of experimental animation, sound and visual magic inside The Impossible Dimension 

🎬 We invite artists from everywhere to submit their work 🌈 all styles and techniques are welcome:
stop motion, pixel art, AI animation, hand drawn, 3D, mixed media and more. 

The only requirement is that is made by you or your team! It can be something that participated in another festivals, or something new! Just have to respect the values of the community 🌱

🗓️ Submissions are open until September 30 ⏳

Everyone can participate!

🎥 The festival screening will take place live in Decentraland on December 1, where all selected works will be showcased and winners announced.

 There will be:

🏆 3 Selected Winners

🎖️ 1 Community Choice Award

🎁 Surprise Prizes!


The submission form and prize details will be shared here soon 📜 stay close fam!


📆 Festival Agenda (December 1)

✨ Doors open & welcome 🧉

✨ Storytelling intro: Impossible Fest

✨ Animations screening 🎬

✨ Community Voting 📝

✨ 3 Official winners announcement 🏆

✨ 1 Community Choice winner

✨ Live DJs to close the night 🎶



Our community is inclusive, kind, and playful 💫 everyone is welcome to join this celebration of creativity, experimentation, and multi dimensional storytelling. Let’s open this festival portal together 🌈

Any updates or changes in the schedule will be announced in advance and reflected in this event page.

💜 This event is fully organized by the community, and all rights to submitted animations remain with their creators!
